exposure: partogram use during trial of labor after previous LSCS
outcome: maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality
cohort: The cohort consisted of 25 patients with a history of previous lower segment cesarean section undergoing a trial of labor.
finding: The study found that partogram use effectively reduced feto-maternal complications and aided in early detection of labor deviations, guiding timely intervention.
mod_finding: Of the patients, 52% underwent repeat LSCS, 32% delivered vaginally, and 20% of vaginal deliveries were instrumental; crossing the partogram alert line indicated a higher likelihood of LSCS.
gest_age: Gestational age ranged from 37 to over 40 weeks, with 84% delivering between 37-40 weeks.
